title: Resolve V03 entry preflight and dependency source questions
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Resolves the fixed-source V03 entry, preflight, dependency and no-op fixture questions. The unchanged Root can authenticate a separately selected control driver. The provider's216 literal runtime entries plus its pinned profile give the independently source-derived successful expectation `authenticated_files=217`. The native-packet direct dependency branch hashes29 fixed inputs without launching the compiler. A future admitted preparation constructor can independently capture original-input modes before child launch instead of guessing them or learning a child answer.

The actual retained C payloads and loader headers are byte-identical across roles, while service headers differ. Equal-content swaps at unchanged paths and equal0444 permission exchanges are no-op positive discriminators. The audit preserves these distinctions and identifies the exact remaining original C05 witness-domain edge.

**No complete V03 family or original activity is claimed.** Category coverage, an exact selected manifest and correct listed hashes do not derive complete project/system-header/search/macro/specs/compiler/link witness membership. The source input round stopped at M1. This is a publication of resolved source findings under the user's new explicit instruction, not a restart or a narrowed-family completion claim.
